@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+# Taskboard CLI
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript task manager for Bun. Tasks are stored in `.taskboard.json` in the current directory, or in the path set by `TASKBOARD_FILE`.
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Ship release" --tags work,urgent --due 2026-09-10
+bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --tag work
+bun run src/cli.ts list --overdue 2026-09-11
+bun run src/cli.ts done 1
+bun run src/cli.ts delete 1
+bun run src/cli.ts stats
+```
+
+Every invocation writes one JSON value to stdout. Errors also write a diagnostic to stderr and exit with a non-zero status. Database updates use a sibling temporary file followed by an atomic rename.

input.command:
set -euo pipefail
TMPDIR_TEST="$(mktemp -d)"
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$TMPDIR_TEST/board.json"
export OUTDIR_TEST="$TMPDIR_TEST"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title "First task" --tags "Work, urgent,WORK" --due 2026-09-03 > "$TMPDIR_TEST/add1.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Second task" --tags home --due 2026-09-05 > "$TMPDIR_TEST/add2.json"
bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --tag work --overdue 2026-09-04 > "$TMPDIR_TEST/filtered.json"
bun run src/cli.ts done 1 > "$TMPDIR_TEST/done1.json"
bun run src/cli.ts done 1 > "$TMPDIR_TEST/done2.json"
bun run src/cli.ts stats > "$TMPDIR_TEST/stats.json"
bun run src/cli.ts delete 1 > "$TMPDIR_TEST/delete.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Third task" > "$TMPDIR_TEST/add3.json"
bun run src/cli.ts list > "$TMPDIR_TEST/list.json"
bun -e 'import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"; const d=process.env.OUTDIR_TEST!; const read=(n:string)=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${d}/${n}.json`,"utf8")); const a1=read("add1"); if(a1.id!==1||a1.status!=="open"||JSON.stringify(a1.tags)!==JSON.stringify(["work","urgent"])||a1.due!=="2026-09-03") throw Error("add normalization failed"); if(JSON.stringify(read("filtered").map((x:any)=>x.id))!=="[1]") throw Error("combined filters failed"); const done1=read("done1"),done2=read("done2"); if(done1.status!=="done"||!done1.completedAt||done1.completedAt!==done2.completedAt) throw Error("done idempotency failed"); const stats=read("stats"); if(stats.total!==2||stats.open!==1||stats.done!==1||stats.overdue!==0) throw Error(`stats failed: ${JSON.stringify(stats)}`); if(read("add3").id!==3) throw Error("stable IDs failed"); if(JSON.stringify(read("list").map((x:any)=>x.id))!=="[2,3]") throw Error("list sorting/deletion failed");'
if bun run src/cli.ts add --title "" > "$TMPDIR_TEST/error-empty.json" 2> "$TMPDIR_TEST/error-empty.stderr"; then exit 20; fi
if bun run src/cli.ts add --title bad --due 2025-02-29 > "$TMPDIR_TEST/error-date.json" 2> "$TMPDIR_TEST/error-date.stderr"; then exit 21; fi
if bun run src/cli.ts list --bogus x > "$TMPDIR_TEST/error-flag.json" 2> "$TMPDIR_TEST/error-flag.stderr"; then exit 22; fi
if bun run src/cli.ts delete 999 > "$TMPDIR_TEST/error-missing.json" 2> "$TMPDIR_TEST/error-missing.stderr"; then exit 23; fi
printf '{not json' > "$TASKBOARD_FILE"
cp "$TASKBOARD_FILE" "$TMPDIR_TEST/before-malformed"
if bun run src/cli.ts stats > "$TMPDIR_TEST/error-malformed.json" 2> "$TMPDIR_TEST/error-malformed.stderr"; then exit 24; fi
cmp "$TASKBOARD_FILE" "$TMPDIR_TEST/before-malformed"
bun -e 'import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"; const d=process.env.OUTDIR_TEST!; for(const n of ["error-empty","error-date","error-flag","error-missing","error-malformed"]){ const out=readFileSync(`${d}/${n}.json`,"utf8").trim().split("\n"); if(out.length!==1) throw Error(`${n}: stdout did not contain exactly one line`); const value=JSON.parse(out[0]); if(typeof value.error!=="string"||!value.error) throw Error(`${n}: invalid error JSON`); if(!readFileSync(`${d}/${n}.stderr`,"utf8").trim()) throw Error(`${n}: missing stderr diagnostic`); }'
printf 'self-tests passed\n'
